issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Kilo Code for JetBrains
products.tagline: Fully native, open-source coding agent built for JetBrains
products.summaryZh: 完全原生的开源编码代理，专为JetBrains打造。
products.descriptionZh: Kilo Code for JetBrains 是一款完全原生的开源编码代理，适用于 IntelliJ IDEA、WebStorm、PyCharm、GoLand、Rider、PhpStorm、CLion、RubyMine——任何 JetBrains IDE。专为本地和远程开发设计，支持在隔离工作树中并行运行代理、内嵌 GitHub PR 和差异对比，并兼容 500 多种模型。
products.description: Kilo Code for JetBrains is a fully native, open-source coding agent for IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, GoLand, Rider, PhpStorm, CLion, RubyMine — any JetBrains IDE. Designed for both local and remote dev, with parallel agents in isolated worktrees, GitHub PRs and diffs inline, and 500+ models.

products.name: Creatium Coach
products.tagline: Your multimedia mentor that takes you from mid to great
products.summaryZh: 你的多媒体导师，助你从平庸走向卓越。
products.descriptionZh: Creatium Coach是一款逼真的多媒体教练，帮助任何人设定并达成目标。无需点击静态课程或模糊回忆视频，你可以在教练的指导下，结合模拟、视频和角色扮演进行学习。这些方式的效果可与一对一面对面辅导相媲美。无论是职业还是个人目标，无论你是单个学习者还是整个企业，Coach都能贴合你的实际情况。警告：副作用可能包括掌控世界。
products.description: Creatium Coach is a lifelike, multimedia coach that helps anyone set goals and reach them. Instead of clicking through static courses or half-remembering a video, you learn with a coach, as well as simulations, videos, and roleplays. These boost outcomes as much as one-on-one in-person coaching. Whatever the goal, professional or personal, and whether you're one learner or a whole enterprise, Coach meets you where you are. Warning: side effects may include world domination.

products.name: Gauth AI Course
products.tagline: AI courses you can watch, quiz through, and create
products.summaryZh: 可观看、测验并创建的AI课程
products.descriptionZh: Gauth的AI课程能将任何学科转化为互动课程，起步包含200多门AI数学课程，覆盖美国高中所有主题，从代数I到AP微积分。AI课程内置视觉资料、思维导图和主动回忆测验，并允许你随时暂停任何课程向AI导师提问。你还可以在几秒内生成自己的课程，按自己的节奏创建个性化课程，并与他人分享。
products.description: Gauth’s AI Course turns any subject into an interactive course, starting with 200+ AI math courses covering every US high school topic, from Algebra I through AP Calculus. The AI Course includes visuals, mindmaps, active-recall quizzes built in and enables you to pause any lesson to ask the AI Tutor a question. You can also generate your own course in seconds, to create personalized lessons at your own pace and share it with others.

products.name: Sider Code
products.tagline: Reshape any website with plain words via Sider extension
products.summaryZh: 使用Sider扩展，用简单文字重塑任何网站。
products.descriptionZh: 30年来，网站定规则。现在，由你来定。在Sider Chrome扩展中，告诉Sider Code你依赖的网站应如何运作。它能理解页面、编写代码并实现更改。你可以保存并控制该功能。
products.description: For 30 years, websites set the rules. Now you do. In the Sider Chrome extension, tell Sider Code how a site you rely on should work. It understands the page, writes the code, and makes the change. You can save and control the feature.

products.name: TrustedRouter
products.tagline: Every model with a unified interface. Privacy with proof.
products.summaryZh: 统一接口的每个模型。隐私，有据可证。
products.descriptionZh: 一个兼容OpenAI的API，支持数百种模型，运行在经认证的基础设施上，端到端加密，提供机密路由、ZDR路由、供应商故障转移、BYOK，且不记录提示或输出日志。
products.description: One OpenAI-compatible API for hundreds of models on attested infrastructure, end to end encryption, with Confidential routes, ZDR routes, provider failover, BYOK, and no prompt or output logs.

products.name: EAS Observe
products.tagline: Performance monitoring built for Expo and React Native
products.summaryZh: 为Expo和React Native构建的性能监控
products.descriptionZh: Observe 可衡量你的 Expo 应用在真实用户设备上的启动速度，以及每个屏幕变得可用的速度。安装库、包裹根布局后，启动指标即自动获取，无需额外插桩。每次原生构建和每次 EAS Update 都会在图表上获得独立标记，便于查看哪个版本影响了性能曲线。每个会话均包含完整设备上下文：型号、操作系统、国家、网络类型、热状态和帧数据。免费计划每月覆盖 10 万事件。
products.description: Observe measures how fast your Expo app starts and how fast each screen becomes usable, on real user devices. Install the library, wrap your root layout, and startup metrics arrive with nothing to instrument. Every native build and every EAS Update gets its own marker on the chart, so you can see which release moved the line. Full device context on every session: model, OS, country, network type, thermal state, frame data. Free plan covers 100K events a month.

products.name: Notchling
products.tagline: A little creature that lives in your MacBook notch
products.summaryZh: 住在你MacBook刘海里的一个小家伙
products.descriptionZh: Notchling是一个住在你MacBook刘海中的小生物。它会注视你的光标，在你闲置时打盹，感知你的电量，当你拖拽文件到它面前时，它会张开嘴帮你叼走。免费，体积不足一兆字节，且所有数据都不会离开你的Mac。
products.description: Notchling is a tiny creature living in your MacBook notch. It watches your cursor, dozes off when you idle, feels your battery, and when you drag a file at it, it opens its mouth and carries it for you. Free, under a megabyte, and nothing leaves your Mac.

products.name: Nodeterm
products.tagline: A node-based free open source terminal manager
products.summaryZh: 基于节点的免费开源终端管理器
products.descriptionZh: 基于节点的免费开源终端管理器，适用于macOS、Linux和Windows。真实终端与编码代理作为无限画布上的实时节点——观察Claude、Codex和Gemini的运行，将它们连接起来，重启也不会丢失任何会话。
products.description: A node-based free open source terminal manager for macOS, Linux and Windows. Real terminals and coding agents as live nodes on an infinite canvas — watch Claude, Codex and Gemini work, wire them together, and never lose a session to a reboot.

products.name: Murmell
products.tagline: Google docs for AI agents, and you can close your laptop
products.summaryZh: 面向AI代理的Google文档，你可以合上笔记本电脑了。
products.descriptionZh: 首次Product Hunt发布为Murmell带来了大量新用户，也让我们意识到基础设施尚不足以支撑扩展。因此，我们从零开始重建了它。我们还创建了统一的代理记忆：合上笔记本电脑，冻结画布，返回时即可回到完全相同的的工作空间、终端、文件和对话。您的代理会保留上下文并从中断处继续，而团队成员可以加入同一实时环境，进行实时协作。
products.description: Our first Product Hunt launch brought many new users to Murmell and showed us that the infrastructure was not ready to scale. So we rebuilt it from scratch. We also created unified agent memory: close your laptop, freeze a canvas, and return to the exact same workspace, terminals, files and conversations. Your agents retain their context and continue where they stopped, while teammates can join the same live environment and collaborate in real time.

products.name: ChannelOS
products.tagline: Turn your local media library into cable-style TV
products.summaryZh: 将本地媒体库转变为有线电视式体验
products.descriptionZh: ChannelOS 是一款本地优先的 Windows 电视系统，可将您已有的媒体转化为持久、可编程的频道。构建自己的电视台，为其设定播放时间表，浏览类似有线电视的电视指南，观看点播内容，并通过适合沙发操作的界面切换频道。无需账户、云服务或媒体上传。当前 alpha 版本免费且以 MPL-2.0 许可证开源。
products.description: ChannelOS is a local-first Windows TV system that turns media you already own into persistent, programmable channels. Build your own stations, give them schedules, browse a live cable-style TV Guide, watch On Demand, and switch channels from a couch-friendly interface. No account, cloud service, or media upload required. The current alpha is free and open source under MPL-2.0.

products.name: Sourclip 2.0
products.tagline: The research workspace built around Gemini Notebook
products.summaryZh: 围绕Gemini Notebook构建的研究工作区
products.descriptionZh: Sourclip是一个围绕Gemini Notebook（原NotebookLM）构建的研究工作空间。从YouTube、网页、Reddit、X、PDF及AI对话（ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini等）中发现并捕获资料，使用文件夹和可复用提示词组织研究，导入YouTube播放列表和频道，编辑思维导图，并将音频概览转化为私人播客。将研究导出为Markdown、HTML或PDF格式，跨项目和设备保持工作流程井然有序。
products.description: Sourclip is a research workspace built around Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM). Discover and capture sources from YouTube, the web, Reddit, X, PDFs, and AI chats (ChatGPT,Claude,Gemini and more), organize research with folders and reusable prompts, import YouTube playlists and channels, edit mind maps, and turn Audio Overviews into private podcasts. Export your research as Markdown, HTML, or PDF and keep your workflow organized across projects and devices.

products.name: ThunderPhone
products.tagline: Platform for building reliable AI phone agents (from 2c/min)
products.summaryZh: 用于构建可靠AI电话代理的平台（低至每分钟2美分）
products.descriptionZh: ThunderPhone是一个自助平台，用于构建AI电话代理。起价每分钟2美分，包含模型。我们的Storm层级，配备额外智能选项，在Big Bench Audio上得分99.4%——评估集已在Hugging Face上公开。构建代理，通过AI呼叫模拟进行测试，监控并引导实时通话，自动检测问题并提供修复建议。支持47种语言。
products.description: ThunderPhone is a self-serve platform for building AI phone agents. From 2¢/min with models included. Our Storm tier, with its extra-intelligence option, scores 99.4% on Big Bench Audio — eval set public on Hugging Face. Build agents, test them with AI-caller simulations, monitor and steer live calls, and get auto-detected issues with proposed fixes. 47 languages.

products.name: Keiki
products.tagline: Build one customer-facing AI agent and launch it everywhere
products.summaryZh: 构建一个面向客户的AI代理，并在各处发布。
products.descriptionZh: 构建一个面向客户的AI代理，并将其部署到短信、iMessage、WhatsApp、Slack、Telegram和电子邮件等渠道。赋予它你的知识、记忆、声音、工具和边界，使其能够回答问题、使用业务系统、完成工作，并在需要人类判断时进行交接。Keiki运行每个渠道背后的共享基础设施，并为你提供一个集中场所来检查对话、批准敏感操作，并随时间改进代理。
products.description: Build one customer-facing AI agent and launch it across SMS, iMessage, WhatsApp, Slack, Telegram, and email. Give it your knowledge, memory, voice, tools, and boundaries so it can answer questions, use business systems, complete work, and hand off when human judgment is needed. Keiki runs the shared infrastructure behind every channel and gives you one place to inspect conversations, approve sensitive actions, and improve the agent over time.

products.name: Folio
products.tagline: A read-later app sending a typeset digest to your e-reader
products.summaryZh: 稍后阅读应用，将排版精美的摘要发送至您的电子阅读器。
products.descriptionZh: 我创建Folio，是因为在手机上阅读时总被通知分心。Folio将你打开的标签页、RSS订阅和新闻简报整合成排版清晰的摘要。它为你提供专属的新闻简报接收邮箱，并去除广告和菜单。随后，它会自动将定制的PDF或EPUB直接发送到你的reMarkable、Kindle或Google Drive。其理念是将阅读转移到电子墨水设备上，让你真正专注。
products.description: I built Folio because I kept getting distracted by notifications when trying to read on my phone. Folio takes your open tabs, RSS feeds, and newsletters, and turns them into a cleanly typeset digest. You get a private email address for newsletters, and it strips out the ads and menus. Then it automatically delivers a custom PDF or EPUB directly to your reMarkable, Kindle, or Google Drive. The idea is to move your reading to an e-ink device, so you can actually focus.

products.name: Happy Shrimp
products.tagline: Alibaba's AI music generator for turning ideas into songs
products.summaryZh: 阿里巴巴的AI音乐生成器，将创意转化为歌曲。
products.descriptionZh: HappyShrimp是阿里巴巴新推出的AI音乐生成器，能将简单创意转化为完整歌曲。描述一种感受、故事、记忆或音乐方向，它便能生成歌词、旋律、编曲和人声。自带歌词、创作纯音乐，并调整乐器、演唱风格、节奏与和弦进行——无需任何制作经验。
products.description: HappyShrimp is Alibaba's new AI music generator for creating complete songs from simple ideas. Describe a feeling, story, memory, or musical direction, and it generates the lyrics, melody, arrangement, and vocals together. Bring your own lyrics, create instrumentals, and shape the instruments, vocal style, tempo, and progression — no production experience required.

products.name: Cosmic Agent Plugins
products.tagline: Connect Cosmic agents to any service with an MCP server
products.summaryZh: 通过MCP服务器将Cosmic代理连接到任何服务。
products.descriptionZh: 你的Cosmic Agents已经能管理你的内容。插件让它们也能在你的其他工具中工作：一个供应商的官方MCP服务器、其技能和一个令牌槽，安装在一个代理上。真实的供应商工具，而非猜测的API调用。GitHub、Stripe、Render、PostHog和Resend今天即可安装。
products.description: Your Cosmic Agents already manage your content. Plugins let them work in your other tools too: a vendor's official MCP server, its skills, and a token slot, installed on one agent. Real vendor tools, not guessed API calls. GitHub, Stripe, Render, PostHog, and Resend install today.

products.name: Tovel AI
products.tagline: From conversation to action, in three steps
products.summaryZh: 从对话到行动，只需三步
products.descriptionZh: 其他AI录音设备主要专注于录音、转录和摘要，而Tovel更进一步——将对话转化为您审阅并批准的实际业务行动。通过深度原生集成，Tovel能创建CRM联系人、线索、商机、预约、任务和提醒，并起草后续邮件。无需自定义Zaps，无需复杂的低代码或无代码工作流。Tovel不仅告诉您发生了什么——它帮助完成接下来要发生的事。
products.description: While other AI recorders focus primarily on recording, transcription, and summaries, Tovel goes further—turning conversations into real business actions that you review and approve. Through deep native integrations, Tovel can create CRM contacts, leads, opportunities, appointments, tasks, and reminders, as well as draft follow-up emails. No custom Zaps. No complicated low-code or no-code workflows. Tovel doesn’t just tell you what happened—it helps complete what happens next.

products.name: Computable GPU Index (CGI)
products.tagline: The first open-source price index for GPU compute
products.summaryZh: 首个开源的GPU算力价格指数
products.descriptionZh: 可计算GPU指数（CGI）是以美元计价的每GPU小时价格，基于一组固定供应商公布的按需租赁费率计算得出。该计算方法在数学上严谨可靠，任何人都能验证并复现每一次发布的数据。
products.description: Computable GPU Index (CGI) is a USD price per GPU-hour, computed from the published on-demand rental rates of a fixed panel of providers. The methodology is mathematically robust, and anyone can verify and reproduce every print.

products.name: HONOR Robot Phone
products.tagline: The phone that literally has a gimbal built in
products.summaryZh: 这款手机内置了真正的云台。
products.descriptionZh: 荣耀机器手机将电动四自由度云台置于旗舰安卓手机内部。其2亿像素主摄可物理移动以稳定拍摄、追踪主体、通话时跟随你，并支持自主拍摄，影像流程内置ARRI LogC3与Looks。
products.description: HONOR Robot Phone puts a motorized 4-DoF gimbal inside a flagship Android phone. Its 200MP main camera can physically move to stabilize shots, track subjects, follow you on calls, and shoot autonomously, with ARRI LogC3 and Looks built into the imaging workflow.

products.name: WaseiGo
products.tagline: Learn the 1,000+ Japanese words that only look like English
products.summaryZh: 学习1000多个看似英文的日语词汇。
products.descriptionZh: 在日本，“consent”（コンセント）指电源插座，而“claim”则是投诉。WaseiGo通过带母语音频的插图双人对话、可搜索词典和图片测验，教授1000多个和制英语——这些看似英语、但含义被日本重新定义的词汇。先猜，再了解缘由。免费精选内容起步；一次性购买解锁全部功能。无订阅。
products.description: In Japan, 'consent' (konsento) means a power outlet and a 'claim' is a complaint. WaseiGo teaches 1,000+ wasei-eigo, the English-looking words whose meanings Japan reinvented, through illustrated two-voice dialogues with native audio, a searchable dictionary, and picture quizzes. Guess first, then learn why. A free selection to start; a one-time purchase unlocks everything. No subscription.
